producer_report.summary: The scope guard now joins a request to a line of work only by the retry link ("try again on <job>") or the unchanged same-text re-ask. A request that cites a paused line's jobs as evidence starts its own line and is no longer refused as paused. I removed the id-in-text scan: the `quotes` field on `RequestRecord`, its computation in `request_records`, and the quotes link in `group_lines`. Doc comments now describe only the two links. A new rig test drives a naturally paused line, then a request citing its two jobs (own line, not paused, dispatched), then a retry of the line (grouped into it, refused with T4). The old quote-based unit test became `grouping_joins_retries_only`. I added a CHANGELOG entry and updated three places in `docs/design/scope-guard.md` that described the old rule. The scope_guard tests, the boundary scan and clippy with warnings denied pass. I did not run the full workspace test suite.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in scope_guard.rs shows a request whose text cites jobs of a paused line is in its own line (group_lines) and is not refused as paused; run `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard`.
criteria_check.evidence: New rig test citing_a_paused_lines_jobs_as_evidence_starts_its_own_line (ask/go, request_records, group_lines, line_pause): groups [[0,1],[2]], line_pause None, request dispatched. Passed in `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard`.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows a retry (retry_of link) of the paused line is still grouped into it and refused; run `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard`, and the existing retry_refuses_paused_line passes.
criteria_check.evidence: Same test continues with 'try again on {b}': retry_of is b, grouping [[0,1,3],[2]], go errs with 'paused' and 'T4'. retry_refuses_paused_line also passed in the same run.

criteria_check.criterion: group_lines and request_records in scope_guard.rs no longer link a request to another by job ids found in its text (diff shows the quotes link removed from grouping); doc comments describe grouping by retry link and same-text re-ask only.
criteria_check.evidence: Removed RequestRecord::quotes, the ids binding, the quotes block in request_records and the .chain(r.quotes.iter()) in group_lines; docs of RequestRecord-grouping, group_lines and request_records now name retry link and same-text re-ask only. Clippy clean, so no leftover unused field/binding.
